text: This report submits the Toronto Zoo 2023 Operating Plan and Budget for approval. The Policy and Finance Committee reviewed the 2023 Operating Plan and Budget on October 3, 2022 and recommended it for approval by the Board.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the 2023 Operating Plan and Budget as attached in Attachment 1 to the report (October 4, 2022) from the Controller, Toronto Zoo.
